flashcard_questions.q: What is an asset in a media product?
flashcard_questions.a: Any file or resource used in the product, such as an image or audio clip.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the purpose of an asset log?
flashcard_questions.a: To record and organise every asset used in a media product.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the purpose of a flowchart?
flashcard_questions.a: To plan the navigation and structure of an interactive media product.

flashcard_questions.q: Which asset log column records whether permission has been granted to use a file?
Which asset log column records where a file came from?
Which flowchart symbol represents a process or action?
Which flowchart symbol marks the start and end points?
What shape is used at a point where the user chooses between outcomes?
Which flowchart symbol shows input or output of data?
Why is an asset log especially important for commercial products?
flashcard_questions.a: Using an image or music track without permission could lead to legal action.

flashcard_questions.q: Which software would you use to build an asset log?
When should a flowchart be used in planning?
flashcard_questions.a: When the product is interactive and the user makes choices.
